text: Crispy Vegetable Salads are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Griogair's Greens in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Copper Ephem Statues are Art Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Yafush Antiques in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Sheba.
Coral Casino are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Hobby Knick-Knacks in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Coralweave Towels are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Fallone Crafts in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Cudsy is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. Cudsy runs a shop called Tomi Fishmongers specialized in Seafood.
Cybine is an NPC in . Cybine is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. Cybine runs a shop called Aldomar Books specialized in Literature.

Cunning Saggie (Japanese: , Rikōna Sagi) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Skwaror family and can be found at level 24 on Minnet Terrace in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, further to the left side of the Titan relative to Yurna the Elderwood. He must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 2 Diabolic Zephyr Affinity Reward.

Crinkly Wools are Textile Pouch items in . They are one of Vale's favorite Pouch items, and can be made using her "Weaving Lv.3" field skill at Vale's Weaving in Fonsett Village, Leftheria. They are unlocked when Vale attains Weaving Lv.3 by making 50 fabrics.
|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Cranberry Bells are Vegetable collectibles in and . They can be found in the Gormott Province, in particular in the Upper Level - Right area, near the Seigle Fell.
Cox is an NPC in . Cox is a Phonex who can be found in Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Cox can only be spoken to if Nim is in the party with level 1 "Phonex Linguistics".
Corcaja Greengrocers is a shop in . It is run by Kroto and can be found in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. It is specialized in Veggies.
Coral Leaf Fresh Fish is a shop in . It is run by Barcan and is located in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. It is specialized in Seafood.
The Corcaja Deeds are Store Deed key items in . They can be purchased from Corcaja Greengrocers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.
The Coral Leaf Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Coral Leaf Fresh Fish in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Crystal Earrings (Japanese: , Kurisutaru Piasu) are accessories in and . They fill the Party Gauge by a large amount when the wearer has an "Excellent" performance on the Button Challenge of a Special. The amount filled with the legendary variant is 34, which is roughly a third of a gauge segment. They are the upgraded version of the Silver Earrings accessory.

Crystal Camellias are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, in particular near the Fonsa Myma Gate or the Gwenith Paddies around where two usually yield. In the , Crystal Camellias can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Curse Branches are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in the Land of Morytha.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Critical Symbols (Japanese: , Kuritikaru Shinboru) are accessories in and . They increase Critical Hit Rate for the whole party during Chain Attacks by up to 54%. The effect stacks for each Critical Symbol equipped in the active party. Since the effect is additive, only two are necessary to guarantee 100% Critical Rate during Chain Attacks.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Crystal Greaves (Japanese: , Kesshō no Suneate) are accessories in and . They increase damage dealt against toppled enemies by up to 85%. They are the upgraded version of Mechanized Greaves accessory. The Graphite Greaves and Staunch Boots accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

Courier (Japanese: , Hakobiya Makushimu) is a shop in which Rex can use to send money to Corinne. It can be found in Goldmouth of the Argentum Trade Guild. It is run by Max and specialized in Other things. To complete the Story Quest Big Job Preparations, Rex must send money to Corinne. Additionally, sending at least 90,000 G to Corinne is a prerequisite for Time is Money.
Courtcoster Salvaging is a shop in . It is run by Apropos and can be found in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. It is specialized in Cylinders.
Cyber Spoons are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at Jubilee Gate at the Cliffs of Morytha.
Crowbell Fruits are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in Elysium on the First Low Orbit Station.

Cube Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be dropped by a wide variety of enemies, primarily in Temperantia and the Cliffs of Morytha, as well as bought from Bamboo Sword Smithy and gifted to Floren by Vestro. In , they can only be dropped by the Ravine Bunnit or found in one Treasure Trove. Cube Chips share their appearance with Polygon Chips, Sphere Chips, and Spiral Chips. __TOC__

Craftsman's Skills is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province during the quest Umon Bounces Back, after completing the mission Shipbuilding Wood. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus" and "Fortitude" Field Skills. Completing this mission unlocks the Merc Mission Titan Shipbuilding.

Core Crystal Hunters is an Info Item in . It can be purchased for 3,000 G from the Informant shop of the Empire of Mor Ardain or the Informant shop in Garfont Village after progressing to Chapter 5. Obtaining the item is a prerequisite for the quest Crystal Clear.

Crispy Blendshakes are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from 12 Brothersisterpon in the Argentum Trade Guild, once all other Brothersisterpon in Alrest have been found and returned to Argentum.
Crane Criminals is a quest in . It can be received from Pettle at Saets Lumber Co. in the Gormott Province.

The Crystal Dome is a Key Item in . It is received from Misimisi during Precious Yearnings by having him appraise a Strange Mineral from a prospecting point near west end of Great Pillar Passage in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Cosmo Peppers are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in Elysium on the First Low Orbit Station.

Custom.WP-RFL-MAG is a Skell weapon mod Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases the number of shots that rifle weapons fire at the cost of reducing their damage. It cannot be crafted at the AM Terminal, and can only be found as a built-in augment on rifle-based Skell weapons. It can be upgraded.
Corinne's Recipe is an Info Item in . It is obtained from Corinne at her house in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. Once obtained, Pyra can cook Acqua Pearl Pazza.

The Coral Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Cooking Display. It enables the purchase of Coral Nopon Chess Sets from the Nopox Hobby Store shop at Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.

The Crispy Veg Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Secret Spice. It enables the purchase of Crispy Vegetable Salad from the Griogair's Greens shop at Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Creeping Slicer is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Calamity Scythe. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0).

Cutting Edge (Japanese: , Shāpuejji, Lit. "Sharp Edge") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Eightfold Edge.

Critical Trigger (Japanese: , Kuritikarutorigā) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Decimation Cannon. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Daring Shot.

Crossing Swords is an Event Track in , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track twelve of disc one from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack. This song plays during the following moments: * Rex duels Malos after being revived by Pyra on the Ancient Ship. * When the battle with Brighid and Padraig ends with Nia and Dromarch being captured, while Rex and Pyra flee. * The party battles Akhos until he decides to flee. * Poppi engages Lila in a duel at the Old Factory. * The party uses their battle strategy against Mikhail and Patroka. * The party and Fan la Norne board the weaponized Judicium Titan. * The party saves Pyra from obliteration by the ether accelerator in Theoscaldia Palace. * Rex con

Cyclonic Blade (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Calamity Scythe. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Gale Blade.

Cruel Musket (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Decimation Cannon. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Ogre Slam.

Cross Edge (Japanese: , Kurosuejji) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Infinity Fans. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Eightfold Edge.

Crazed Bazooka (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Decimation Cannon. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Laserpoint Bazooka.
Crafty Zofka (Japanese: , Kōkatsu no Zofu) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . He is a Driver enemy fought at level 68 at the Titan Weapon Dig Site in Temperantia during the DLC quest The Lone Watchman.
Crustip Chitin is an enemy part Collectible in . They can be dropped from Krim Crustips in the Kingdom of Uraya. Four are needed for the quest True Colors.

Critical Restore is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It provides special healing, restoring Tora's HP by up to 30% of the damage inflicted with each Critical Hit. It is equivalent in effect to the Classic Medal, Modern Medal and Avant-Garde Medal accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
Cultock is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can be found in the Admar Storage Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. She is spoken to during the quest Failure and Success.
Curse of the Zekenator is a Heart-to-Heart in . It can be found south of Three-Vein Crossroads in the Kingdom of Tantal. Viewing this Heart-to-Heart will reset the weather to be clear.
Custavio is an NPC in . He is an Indoline shopkeeper who can be found at Quattor Street in the Indoline Praetorium. He runs the shop Regulus Blacksmiths. Custavio offers no quests or Merc missions.
Core Chips are an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Market of Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Crystal Fortunes is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at Kedeigh Gate in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Crossing Bridges is a DLC Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal automatically after completing the DLC Merc Mission Titan Battleship Fixes. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist" and "Fortitude" Field Skills. It uniquely awards more Merc Points than any other normal Merc Mission, offering the largest Merc Point reward in the game at 500 points per clear.
Custinah is an NPC in . She is an Indoline who can be found at Poldis Circle in the Indoline Praetorium. She runs Calceno Deli.
Corden is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at the Grave Robbers' Haunt in Spirit Crucible Elpys during Difficult Decisions.

Covn Pippitos (Japanese: , Kobun Pipitto) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family fought at level 25 during the Challenge Battle Grazing Flock. They are summoned by Gostell Buloofo when using its art "Beast Howl". This enemy drops no items.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Crimson Headbands (Japanese: , Shinku no Hachimaki) are DLC accessories in . They increase the damage of Critical Hits by up to 60%. They are the upgraded version of the Iron Headband, Ice Headband and Optical Headband accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

Crimson Orchid Brighid (Japanese: ) is a DLC Aux Core in . It increases Evasion Rate by 16% when the Affinity between Driver and Blade is at max. This effect persists until the golden bond dissipates. It also changes Brighid's appearance when she equips the core, granting her a red color scheme. It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange for 30 Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. The Jade Orchid Brighid DLC Aux Core has an equivalent effect, which is functionally identical to the Affinity MAX Evade V Aux Core.

Cornflower Poppi α (Japanese: , Hana JS Blue Custom) is a DLC Skill RAM or Upgrade in . It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. It is unlocked after the Nopon Invitation is collected from the Helpful New Features released as part of the version 1.5.1 update and can be purchased at the Noponstone Exchange for 200 Noponstones in the Land of Challenge. If equipped to Poppi α, it changes her outward appearance to a blue variant of her standard outfit.

Crossette's Cooking is a kitchen in at which Crossette can prepare Pouch food items from various Collectibles. The kitchen is located in Tora's House in Gormott. The dishes Crossette makes are not sold by any Shops. Recipes are unlocked by leveling up her "Ardent Cooking" Field Skill. This can be achieved by talking to Lenka, Rami, Nascion and Elvira, in that order, and then completing her Blade Quest Bright Spark. Unlike with Pyra's Cooking, Crossette cannot cook multiple dishes at once.

Corvin's Approach (Japanese: , Kamuya no Ryūgi, Corvin's Methods) is a DLC Blade Quest in . After updating to version 1.5.2, this quest is unlocked after awakening Corvin from "New Rare Blade Pack 3". It can be received from Marcel at the Royal Audience Hall in the Kingdom of Tantal.

The Cropwoods of Yorn (Japanese: , Shūkaku no Mori Yorun) are a location in . They are at the end of the path that is north of the Secluded Boneway, directly before Feltley Village. Three Chelta Caterpiles fall from the trees in the middle of the path when approached, and the Quest-exclusive Enemies can be found here during A Simple Errand.

The Crooked Tower (Japanese: , Yugami no Tō) is a location in . It is a bone spiral walkway located in the Tornan Titan Interior, between Balaur, Dark Zone #1 and Fernyiges, Dark Zone #2. There are two Treasure Troves here, and a Titan Antibody Core that exclusively spawns Youse Parisax which must be defeated in order to continue.

The Coolley Lake Camp (Japanese: , Kūreru-ko no Kyanpu) is a landmark in . It is a Campsite located in the eastern area of Gormott, on the southeastern corner of Coolley Lake. There are no enemies here.
Crucible (Japanese: , Rengoku) is one of Brighid's Rear Guard Arts in .

The Creef Griffox (Japanese: , Gurīfu Repādo) is a Quest-exclusive enemies in . It is a members of the Griffox family and can be found at level 43 in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, in Lasaria Woodland. It must be defeated during Trail of Destruction. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , the Creef Griffox drops no items, only gold.
Cotton Charms are Charm items in . They can be created by Lora at Campsites.
Cotton Branches are Tree collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Corkscrew Creepers are Tree collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Curious Rotting Leavess are Tree collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
Creeping Starpeppers are Vegetable collectible items in . They can be found south of Hoary Weald Camp in Gormott.

Coora Nest (Japanese: , Kūra Nesuto) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Nest family, and can be found at level 31-38 on Hoary Weald Camp, Valafum Hill, Saints' Practice Grounds, Hoary Weald, and Nebley Wind Cave in Gormott.

Cursed Buloofos (Japanese: , Kāsudo Urusu) are story exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Buloofo family, and can be found at level 2 in the Lasaria Woodland in the Kingdom of Torna. Alongside the Raging Volffs and Jubel Feris, they are the first enemies of the game. As with all story exclusive enemies in , this enemy drops no items, only gold.
The Critic's Fan is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Addam at Campsites.

The Cragmaw Caverns (Japanese: , Ganmon Dōkutsu) are a location in . It is a short passage located on the Bionis' Shoulder, between where Junks crashed and Cinnabar Plateau. There are no enemies within the cavern itself, although there is one Ponspector on either side; Tentoo and Evelen.

Cream Wheats (Japanese: , Kuryimugi) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to their description, they are a grain with a refined mellow flavour, and the chaff can be delicious steamed. Three bunches of them are needed for A Surefire Hit. They become easier to obtain after completing New Way of Life, as the new collection points at Halcyon Wheats have increased odds of collecting them.

Cyclonic Yughana (Japanese: , Gufū no Yuguna) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Tokilos family, and can be found at level 70 at Old King's Testament on the Bionis' Shoulder, accompanied by two level 68 Leg Tokilos.
Custodian Barreldart (Japanese: , Chingo no Barerudaruto) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Fogbeast Torta, and can be found at level 71 at Gamaro Hollow on the Bionis' Shoulder.

Cutpurse Igna (Japanese: , Ukan no Igūna) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 75 on the small hill north of Clear Sky Bluff on the Bionis' Shoulder during Priority Wunwun. It must be defeated to complete the quest. Upon defeat, it drops Somebody's Memo. As with all Quest Exclusive Enemies in , the Cutpurse Igna drops no chest.
Dadapon's Gift (Japanese: , Tōchan kara no Okurimono) is a Quiet Moment in . It is located west of Halcyon Wheats on the Bionis' Shoulder, between Shulk and Kino once Gran Dell has been visited.
Crushing Twister (Japanese: , Sukuryūkurasshā, Lit. "Screw Crusher") is Roc's Level II Blade Special in .
Crimson Storm (Japanese: , Kurimuzonsutōmu) is Roc's Level IV Blade Special in .

Cruel World (Japanese: , Souhansekai) is Obrona's Level III Blade Special in . Cruel World is also Obrona's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the . Obrona conjures a giant blast of red energy.
Corsaire Gogols are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 33-35 in High Maktha Wildwood in the Pentelas Region.
Costa Balgas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Balgas family, and can be found at level 41-42 around Ekdaso Verge on the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Crash Out (Japanese: , Kurasshuauto) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Heavy Guard class. It becomes a usable Master Art upon unlocking the class.

The Cotte Fountainhead (Japanese: , Konti no Gensen) is a Secret Area in , located at the Great Cotte Falls, accessible from the High Maktha Wildwood. A duo of Unique Monsters, Saberly Dorampé and Stately Doramma can be found here.

Craven Piggard (Japanese: , Kyōda no Pogādo) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Kapiba family, and can be found at level 38 at Hovering Reef 3 in Syra Hovering Reefs. The "Nimbleness Itself" Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
The Cotte Outlook (Japanese: , Konti no Chōbō) is a Location in . It is located at the Great Cotte Falls, on top of a structure from the Land of Morytha.

The Cotte Trick Ruins (Japanese: , Konti no Karakuri Iseki) is a Location in . It is located west of the Cascade Ferronis Hulk at the Great Cotte Falls. The Phantasmagorical Rist Unique Monster can be found here.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Cracked Crystals are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Tableland Caravan and Tunnel Caravan. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Smothering Andante.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Crystalline Chemises are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Colony Tau Commissary and Old Way Caravan. The legendary variant can be purchased at the Prize X-change Red, or dropped from Altruistic Maribel. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Gotthard, the Ethereal.
The Coolley Pool Camp (Japanese: , Kūreru Suimyaku no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located near Coolley Pool on Melnath's Shoulder.
Coolley Pool (Japanese: , Kūreru Suimyaku) is a Location in . It is located on Melnath's Shoulder in the Aetia Region. The water in this pool flows from Coolley Lake.

The Cradle Convoy Shelter (Japanese: , Yurikago Yusō Butai: Yaeichi) is a Landmark in . It is located at the Pedesto Valley Floor at the Great Sword's Base. It becomes available during Side Story: Lanz. It is a temporarily stationed convoy for Cradles. After Side Story: Lanz, numerous Keves Forces appear here.
Culinary Repertoire (Japanese: , Densetsu no Ryūgi) is a Ascension Quest in , dedicated to Riku & Manana. It can be received at Hykt's Cove in Erythia Sea.

Crystalline DuGarre (Japanese: , Gōshō no Dugarū) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 27 at the Alefa Skysphere in the Dannagh Desert. The Cursed Cuisine Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class for defeating it.

Crafty Anskey (Japanese: , Kōchi no Ansukī) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Wisp family, and can be found at level 54 at Yunnae's Rise at Elaice Highway. The Revenge Impetus Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class for defeating this monster.

Covetous Gerondon (Japanese: , Yokushin no Geronodon) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Rhana family, and can be found at level 60 at Cape Arcaphor in Erythia Sea, in an area accessible from Welkin Falls. The Aquaball Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Cruelfist Rojou (Japanese: , Jaken no Ribyou) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Droid, and can be found at level 66 at the Amplifier Section in the Origin Interior, nearby the Amplifier Control Room. It forms the trio "Armbenders" with Ghostfist Róisín and Trickfist Tuano. The Recharge Cheer Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Creeping Hameel (Japanese: , Haiyoru Hamaeru) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Flak family, and can be found at level 67 at Amplifier No. 2 in the Origin Interior. The Attack Mastery Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

The Cross-Maktha Elevator (Japanese: , Morukuna Jūdan Shōkōki) is a Location in . It is an elevator that travels between the two levels of Maktha Wildwood in the Pentelas Region. This elevator travels between the Colony Tau Watchtower in High Maktha Wildwood and the southern-most part of Low Maktha Wildwood. The elevator must be used in Low Maktha Wildwood at least once before it is available to ride from Colony Tau. According to Graziana, the elevator was locked after Colony Tau was invaded by the Tirkins a few decades in the past.
Crispy Peaches are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced from the Desert Ferronis Hulk Fabricator, or the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Curegrasses are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be produced from the Cascade Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Cracker Nuts are Seed Collectibles in and . They can be found in the Aetia Region in . They can also be produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk or Hillside Ferronis Hulk Fabricators. They can be found in The Ragmos Desolation in . It can be purchased from the Colony 9 Caravan.

Crazed Ignas are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 45 at the Igna Conglomerate on Elaice Highway, and level 96-99 in Rebellion Cave at Erythia Sea in the Cadensia Region.
Cuyask Garaffas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Garaffa family, and can be found at level 51-52 at Yunnae's Rise on Elaice Highway.
Coruscant Corals are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Cured Armu Sirloins are items in and . They can be obtained from the Armu species of enemies across Aionios. The rare variant can also be purchased from Sunny & Cheerio's Caravan. In , the common variant can also be purchased from the Col. 9 Supply Office (New).

Creamy-Dreamy Fish Pies are Meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. One Silver Nopon Coin can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients. It is unlocked by purchasing the Sunny-Style Fish Pie from the Colony Mu Canteen for the first time.

Crumblecrunch Block Bars are Meal items in . They can be cooked by Manana at Rest Spots. One Silver Nopon Coin can be used to cook this meal instead of the necessary ingredients. It is unlocked after purchasing the Nutritious Block Bar from the Central Cell Canteen for the first time.
Curran Feris are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Feris family, and can be found at level 43-44 at the Great Sword's Base in the Cadensia Region.
Cry of Faith is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Signifer class.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Crushing Weapon Belts are Accessories in and . The legendary variant can be obtained from Littlefort Morley. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Sensational Gigapur.
Crystal Anklets are Accessories in . It can be purchased from the Illicit Caravan, or dropped by Profound Hodzuki.
Coralie's Ring is a Key Item in . It is a ring belonging to Coralie that she lost. The party retrieves it for her during The Path I Forge.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Cosmos Anklets are Accessories in . The legendary variant can be obtained from Defiled Ishtar.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Cyrus Leg Frames are Accessories in and . The legendary variant can be obtained from Ghosting Lulika or Dreadwyrm Nizoont. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Many-Lived Derrick.
Cozy Rhogul Egggems are items in . They are dropped by Rhoguls. One is needed during Happiness.

Curran Volffs are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 40-41 on the Syra Hovering Reefs. Three are also fought at level 60 during the first wave of the Challenge Battle Ouroboros Fever.
Cured-Meat Vizzards are Meal items in . They can be purchased from The Tap-Dancing Nopon. Purchasing it for the first time unlocks the Ritzy-Glitzy Saucy Vizzard for Manana's Menu.
Crusader For Spuds is a Standard Quest in . Zeon must be in the party.

Crimson Lance (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Seraph class. It becomes a usable Master Art upon reaching Rank 10 with the class. The user raises their fiery lance and swings it hard to the left. Cammuravi's version has him swing the fiery lance to the left and right.

Cursed Cuisine is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Crystalline DuGarre while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.
Craft Accessories is a DLC mechanic in , unlocked during Lapidarist Extraordinaire.

Critical Rate Up is a Status Effect in and . It improves the user's Critical Rate multiplicatively (for example, a character with a Critical Rate of 20% will have their Critical Rate boosted to 25% with the base version of the buff).

Critical Hit Plus is a Status Effect in and . It increases the damage dealt by a character whenever they land a critical hit. The effect works additively, so for example the base 50% boost together with the normal critical damage boost of 25% results in critical hits dealing 75% extra damage.
Counter Heal is a Status Effect in . It heals the affected character whenever they get hit, for a set amount of times, after which the buff is removed.
Custom Diving Band Ls are Casual Wear left arm armor in . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are apart of the Custom Diving armor range.
Custom Diving Band Rs are Casual Wear right arm armor in . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are apart of the Custom Diving armor range.
Custom Diving Masks are Casual Wear head armor in . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are apart of the Custom Diving armor range.
Custom Diving Pants are Casual Wear leg armor in . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are apart of the Custom Diving armor range.
Custom Snorkels are Casual Wear head armor in . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are apart of the Custom Diving armor range.
Custom Swimsuit Bottoms are Casual Wear leg armor in . They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are apart of the Custom Swimsuit armor range.
The Curry Recipe is a Key Item in . It allows the party to cook Georgie's Special Curry at Rest Spots. It is obtained upon completing Georgie's Ask.
Cutting-Edge Aloes are Plant Collectibles in . They can be found on The Ragmos Desolation.
Cyclone Form ( Saikuronfōmu) is a Chain Art in . It is Nikol's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.
Cyclone Onslaught ( Saikuronreido, Lit. "Cyclone Raid") is Matthew & Nikol's Chain Art in . This art is based on Mathew's Avalanche Onslaught and Nikol's Cyclone Form. <!--
Corporal Ignas are two Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Igna family that are fought at level 52 in Zalmor's Thawtunnels on the Aurora Shelf during Takedown: Ignas.
Cryoconite Laurel (Japanese: , Yūketsu no Aguakate) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Moglum family, and can be found at level 26 in the Lakeside Grotto in Yesterdale.
Cradles (Japanese: , Yurikago), also known as growth modules are objects in .

Counterattack is a track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track one of disc three from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track one of disc eight from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments:
The Crisp Will Peppers are an Important Item in . They are more crispy and lustrous Will Peppers that can be found at the North Coast in Oblivia. One must be collected during One Big Happy Family.

Cos-Cute Drones I are Mechonis Drones in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2800 for the first time with Fiora in the Score Attack course Rural Road. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4800 Noponstones.

Cos-Cute Drones II are Mechonis Drones in . They can be obtained by winning with Fiora for the first time on the Battle Race course Colony 9 Wild Ride. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 7200 Noponstones.

Cos-Cute Bands II are Mechonis goggles in . They can be obtained by winning with Fiora for the first time on the Battle Race course Twilight Speedway. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 6000 Noponstones.

Cos-Cute Bands I are Mechonis goggles in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2000 for the first time with Fiora in the Score Attack course Caterpile Circuit. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 4000 Noponstones.

Cos-Cute Frames I are Mechonis frame armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2200 for the first time with Fiora in the Score Attack course Jungle Rumble. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 6700 Noponstones.

Cos-Cute Frames II are Mechonis frame armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Fiora for the first time on the Battle Race course Midnight Forest. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 10000 Noponstones. They can only be worn by Fiora.

Cos-Cute Arms II are Mechonis arms in . They can be obtained by winning with Fiora for the first time on the Battle Race course Alcamoth at Dawn. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 3900 Noponstones.

Untamed Arms I are Mechonis arms in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2400 for the first time with Fiora in the Score Attack course Alcamoth Orbital. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 2600 Noponstones.

Cos-Cute Boosters II are Mechonis leg armour in . They can be obtained by winning with Fiora for the first time on the Battle Race course Blizzard Rally. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 7800 Noponstones.

Cos-Cute Boosters I are Mechonis leg armour in . They can be obtained by achieving a score of 2600 for the first time with Fiora in the Score Attack course Valak Slalom. They can also be purchased from Time Attack for 5200 Noponstones.
|-|Real Mode= |-|Imaginary Mode= Crown End (Japanese: , Kuraun'endo) is MOMO's Level IV Blade Special in . When MOMO is in Imaginary Mode, this Special becomes Crown End (Dark).
Crall is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found at night under Garagorm's Arch in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Cylinders are items in They can be purchased from Shops and are used at Salvage Points for Salvaging.
Cyua is a Japanese vocalist. She is the singer of Wir fliegen from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack.

Da Dorde (Japanese: , Da Dorude) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a level 38 Wrothian and is fought alongside Gi Bordo, Gu Galda, Zo Zongra in Sylvalum during the squad mission The Wrothian Four.
The Cracker-PD is an spare weapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Coronids or black Quos.
The Cracker-BM is an spare weapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Coronids or black Quos.
The Cracker-FL is an spare weapon for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Coronids or black Quos.
Critical Chance Down is a debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces the character's chance to score a critical hit.

Dark Mangoes (Japanese: , Dāku Mangō) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, they often sneak into boxes of sweet mangos and they make someone feel blue.

The Dawn Hydrangeas (Japanese: , Sachiberia) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9 and later in Colony 6. According to their description, they are yellow flowers that bring good luck to the finder and they are good for pressing. Five are needed for Flattened Flowers.
Deki (Japanese: , Deku) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. He can be found on the first basement floor in Frontier Village, southeast of the Nopon Tower, in the southeastern corner of the map.
Dean (Japanese: , Dīn) is a Homs in . He can be found south of the Weapon Development Lab of Colony 9, in an alley. He is active from 6:00 - 15:00.

Dark Grapes (Japanese: , Kurabudou) are collectables in . They can be found in Tephra Cave. According to their description, they are mature black grapes with a concentrated sweetness. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 2,500 Noponstones.

Dark Murakmor (Japanese: , Tokoyami no Murakumo) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Tokilos family. It can be found at level 18 on the slope of Anti-Air Battery 3 in Colony 9 at night. Defeating it is necessary to complete the quest The Plan - Execution, given by Sesame at Colony 9. It is the weakest Tokilos/Taos (by level) in the game.

Dance Apples (Japanese: , Odoringo) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9. According to their description, they are red apples that are perfect for parties and they really get things moving. Five are required for A Curry Conundrum.

※ After this quest is completed, Liliana may offer another quest. See Liliana's Sincere Request. Dean's Shady Request (Japanese: , Dīn no Yokoshimana Negai) is a quest in . It can be received from Dean in the southern alley of the Weapon Development Lab in the Military District of Colony 9. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment.

Delerium Foxgloves (Japanese: , Bokujubiora) are collectables in . They can be found in Sword Valley and Colony 6. According to their description, they are delicate black flowers of great rarity that take their nutrients from charcoal.

Darkness Bottles (Japanese: , Haikurou Boteru) are collectables in . They can be found in Sword Valley and Colony 6. According to their description, Melia named them with pride and they appear darker and deeper than the night.

Decoration Makeover (Japanese: , Kawaii Oheya ni Daihenshin) is a quest in . It can be received from Pepa in the Chief's Residence in Frontier Village. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment.

This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Dangerous Ambition (Japanese: , Kiken'na Yabō) is a Timed Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Cherri at the Pollen Orb Storehouse in Frontier Village after completing The Master's Successor (the choice in The Master's Successor does not affect this quest). If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.

Death Bangles (Japanese: , Hissatsu Banguru) are collectables in . They can be found on Bionis' Leg. According to their description, Reyn named them on the spot and they are made from viciously sharp fangs.

Dawn Dice (Japanese: , Chōyō no Saikoro) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, Reyn was daydreaming when he named these pretty dices made of red stone.

The Daring of the Giants is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the three Giants' key items found, the other two being the Truth of the Giants and the Heart of the Giants. These three items are required to open the door at Three Sage Summit, and are required for The Giants' Treasures and The Final Giants' Ruins. To obtain the Daring of the Giants, a chain of quests in Satorl Marsh must be completed: Kacha's Kidnapping, The Giants' Key and The Giants' Treasure.

Dark Fish (Japanese: , Dāku Fisshu) are collectables in . They can be found on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they are highly acrobatic swimmers and a big tank is needed if someone makes them pets.

Daksha Shrine (Japanese: , Dakusha Shinden) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Bionis' Leg, northeast of Viliera Hill. It houses the Clifftop Bayern, which is guarding the Giants' Mirror required for The Giants' Treasure. There is a narrow path here which leads up to a Secret Area, the Observation Platform.

The Dark Swamp (Japanese: , Fukakiyami no Numa) is a location in . It is located in Satorl Marsh, west of Exile Fortress. Similar to the Poison Swamp, the purple liquid in the swamp will damage the party, but this can be mitigated by using Terrain Defence gems.

Daza (Japanese: , Gaza) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. He can be found at the Hope Farm Shop in Colony 6. Initially this shop is located outside the north gate to Colony 6, but after the liberation of Colony 6 it moves to a point a short distance north of Hope Farm. He gives the party several quests.

Debuff Resist (Japanese: , Zen Debafu Teikō, All Debuff Resist) is a Gem in and that increases resistance to all debuffs, including Instant Death. It does not protect against Topple, Daze, and Blow-Down, which are classified as status ailments rather than debuffs. __TOC__

Delicious Vang Tails are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Vangs in Makna Forest, or traded for in Frontier Village. According to their description, they are tails considered a delicacy with a taste that is nothing special. Three of them are needed for the A route of Popularity Premonition.
Daze Tension (Japanese: , Kizetsu Tenshon) is a Gem in Xenoblade Chronicles that increases Tension when attacking a Dazed enemy. __TOC__
Delivering Food (Japanese: , Obentōbako wo Todokeru, Delivering a Bento Box) is a Story Quest in . It can be received in Dunban's House in Colony 9 after Shulk has entered the Weapon Development Lab.
Defence Knives (Japanese: , Difensunaifu) are weapons in . They are Fiora's knives, and can be dropped by enemies in Tephra Cave or traded for with Peppino.

Dazzling Tolosnia (Japanese: , Senkō no Torosunia) is a quest exclusive Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 97 in the spider room southwest of the Heavenly Window in Tephra Cave during The Blood of Bafalgar. It drops the White Spider Heart item. The item is then placed on the altar inside Bafalgar Tomb to reveal a door that leads deeper within the tomb.

Defenders (Japanese: , Difendā) are unique weapons in . They are gunlances wielded by Reyn, and can be obtained from various low-leveled enemies in Colony 6 and Satorl Marsh. Defenders are not otherwise available.

※ After this quest is completed, Pachipa may offer another quest. See It Definitely Exist!. Dadapon in Trouble (Japanese: , Tо̄chan ga Shinpai) is a quest in . It can be received from Pachipa at the Archaeology Centre in Frontier Village. To trigger the quest, the party must talk to Gerugu then Pachipa, registering their relationship as orange on the Affinity Chart. Gerugu can be found at the Traveller's Rest on Bionis' Leg. If Melia in the active party, she will comment.
Darkness Sickles (Japanese: , Mumyōjōya no Kama) are weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban.
Delta Rifles (Japanese: , Derutaraifuru) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are ether rifles wielded by Sharla.
Dark Cannons (Japanese: , Dākukyanon) are weapons that appeared in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are rifles that can be wielded by Sharla.
The Danger Sniper (Japanese: , Denjāsunaipu) is an ether rifle in , usable by Sharla. It is not effective against Mechon.
Delay Blades (Japanese: , Direiburēdo) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are twin blades wielded by Fiora.
The Dawn Staff (Japanese: , Chūya no Tsue, Staff of Night and Day) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a staff and is useable by Melia.

The Decayed Forest (Japanese: , Fuhai shita Mori) is a location in . It is located in Makna Forest. It is located south of Yellow Flower Grove, and northeast from Precipice Bridge and Glowmoss Trihenge.

Daughter Armus (Japanese: , Dōtā Aruma) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Armu family, and can be found at level 10 alongisde Leg Ardun and Leg Armus in Gaur Plain on Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Thick Armu Milk needed for Cook-Off Counter Attack!.

Deinos Sauros (Japanese: , Dinoru Saurā) are enemies in . They can be found in Makna Forest and are mostly seen at level 98. Although its name contains the word "Deinos", it is not a member of the Deinos family, and the two have different names in Japanese (, Dinoru vs. , Dinosu).

Dark Hoxes (Japanese: , Ātorumu Hoggusu, Ātrum Hox) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Hox family, and can be found from level 74-76 on Raguel Bridge. They can drop the Hox Daylight Spur needed for Replica Monado 3 and Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Decay Ekidnos (Japanese: , Hōkai no Ekidona) are three quest exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Ekidno family, and can be found on ledges on the Syrath Lighthouse on Hovering Reef 4 in the Eryth Sea. Three of them must be defeated for the quest Trouble at the Lighthouse. During this quest, they can only be fought at night. They drop Ekidno Jaw Gristles, five of which are needed for Getting Bigger!.
Dated Plates are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by M80-type Mechon on the Fallen Arm.
Daze Resist (Japanese: , Kizetsu Teikō) is a Gem in . It increases the chance of resisting Daze. __TOC__

Daze Up (Japanese: , Kizotsu Iryoku Appu) is a Gem in Xenoblade Chronicles. It increases the damage dealt to Dazed enemies. This Gem type should not be confused with "Daze Plus", a gem which lengthens the duration of the Daze status effect. __TOC__

Daze Plus (Japanese: , Kizetsu Jikan Purasu, Daze Time Plus) is a Gem in . It increases the duration of Daze inflicted on enemies. The Battle Arts that are affected by this gem include: * Cross Impact * Head Shaker * Hidden Thorn * Mag Storm * Shaker Edge * Shield Bash * Thunder This Gem type should not be confused with "Daze Up", a gem that increases damage dealt to dazed enemies. __TOC__
Debuff Plus (Japanese: , Debafu Jikan Tsuika, Debuff Time Add) is a Gem in that increases the duration of Debuffs inflicted on enemies. __TOC__
Damage Heal (Japanese: , Damēji Hīru) is a Gem in and that grants a chance to recover HP when attacked. __TOC__

Dark King Barbarus (Japanese: , Meiō no Barubarusu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Drakos-type member of the Telethia family, and can be found at level 77 on the platform east of the Second Lung in Bionis' Interior.

Defend Colony 6 - Reptile (Japanese: , Koronī 6 wo Mamore: Hi) is a quest in . It is received automatically when the party has access to Eryth Sea and the reconstruction reaches 35%. This quest requires the party to kill five Fiery Ignas at the Ether Planter located at the crossroads southeast from Freight Road. They can be found near the cliff on the east side of the road, close to the point where the the paths from the Pod Depot and Freight Road intersect.

Dark Kisling (Japanese: , Kurayami no Kisuringu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Vang family. It can be found at level 20 east of the Central Terminal entrance, the room containing the large fire crystal deposit, in the Ether Mine .

Defective Ipos (Japanese: , Rōkyū no Iposu) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a level 50 Mechon found on the west side of the Ether Storage Area in Sword Valley patrolling at the head of a group.

Defensive Kromars (Japanese: , Shusei no Supikaru) are four story exclusive and quest exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Kromar family, and can be found at level 36 on Ether Crystal Deposit in the Eryth Sea. Four of them guard the High Entia worker that must be rescued in the Story Quest Save the Worker.

Defend Colony 6 - Demon (Japanese: , Koronī 6 wo Mamore: Arashi) is a quest in . It is the last quest given by the residents of Colony 6 to defend the colony. It is received automatically when the reconstruction reaches 95%. The party must defeat Demon King Dragonia, a level 99 Dragon at Hope Farm. He is one of the two enemies that drops Demonic Everflames—the other being the Superboss Avalanche Abaasy—needed for Replica Monado 4, as well as the only enemy to hold all three pieces of slotted Ledios armour and the only enemy in the game to have slotted Ledios Arms. Players may therefore wish to leave Demon King Dragonia alive until Riki's Yoink! skill is used to obtain as many of

Daughter Empress (Japanese: , Dōtā Enpuresu) is a one-of-a-kind quest exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is not a Unique Monster. It is a member of the Arachno family, and can be found only during It Definitely Exist!. It is in a small cave northwest of the Windy Cave on Bionis' Leg. This cave can only be reached by jumping down into the small hole directly south of Zax Guidepost, as instructed by Gerugu. The Daughter Empress drops the Empress' Ornament, which is required to complete the quest.

Daksha Pods are stationary enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Pods, and can be found on Bionis' Leg near Daksha Shrine. Daksha Pods release Basin Antols, Leg Antols, Prairie Antols, and Ravine Antols. If they are killed before they hatch, they will drop Arachno Silk, which is needed for Arachno Silk Fundraising.
This quest will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Daring Assault (Japanese: , Kyōkōtoppa) is a Timed Surprise Quest in . It can be received at the Mechon Factory in Central Factory.

The Defensive Guard Unit is a story exclusive and quest exclusive Mechon in . It can be found at level 53 at Face Maintenance Bay in Galahad Fortress during the story event and quest Fiora's Conviction. It is defending Face Nemesis along with another variant, one M94 Guard Unit and its variant. It owns 53,800 HP, it does not respawn nor drop any Treasure Chest.

Delivering the Undeliverable (Japanese: , Komatta Nandemoya) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Shilx lying on upstairs near the Main Entrance in Colony 6. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.

Dated Plugs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by M35 Prototype units on the Fallen Arm, and cannot be traded for. According to their description, they are an ancient type of part that would work best if displayed as an antique. Dated Cranks and Dated Frames share the same description. Three are needed for the quest Odd Smoke - Resolution.

Dated Cranks are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Scout Unit Prototypes on Digit 5 Beach of the Fallen Arm, and are not available for trade. According to their description, they are an ancient type of part that would work best if displayed as an antique. Dated Frames and Dated Plugs share the same description. Three of them are needed for Odd Smoke - Resolution.
The Deinos Hook is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Finding it is the objective of Search Quest 2 in Frontier Village. It can be found in Apex Lake at the top level of Frontier Village.

Dated Frames are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by M56 Prototypes on the Fallen Arm or traded for. According to their description, they are an ancient type of part that would work best if displayed as an antique. Dated Cranks and Dated Plugs share the same description. In order to successfully complete the quest Fixing a Broken Door, the party must collect two of them.
Defend Colony 6 - Elite (Japanese: , Koronī 6 wo Mamore: Chō) is a quest in . It is received automatically when the party reaches Fallen Arm and the reconstruction reaches 55%.
Defend Colony 6 - Ancient (Japanese: , Koronī 6 wo Mamore: Tori) is a quest in . It is received automatically when the reconstruction reaches 75%.
Defend Colony 6 - Mechon (Japanese: , Koronī 6 wo Mamore: Ki) is a quest in . It is received automatically when the party has access to Makna Forest and the reconstruction reaches 15%.

The Deepwater Fish is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received from Theo during Food Delivery after giving him the Boxed Meal from Natalia. He asks the party to deliver it to Natalia for him.
The Data Centre is a location in . It is located on the third floor of Agniratha, at the top of the Central Tower. Information on the history of Agniratha can be accessed here.
Daza's Letter is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received from Daza when accepting Secret Mission and is to be delivered to Gerugu.

The Defence Force is an organised militia seen in . The intent of the Defence Force is to protect Colony 9 and Colony 6's residents from harm, whether it be from monsters or from Mechon invasions. The Defence Force has its own district in Colony 9, the Military District, where soldiers and scientists work together in a joint effort to more easily defend the colony.

Dedeba's Evidence are Key Items in Xenoblade Chronicles. There are four of them, and all of them must be found for Evidence Collection. Two are at the Pollen Works, one is at the Pollen Orb Storehouse, and one is in the Underground Store.

Data Probes are information and research devices in that retrieve data in the surrounding area. By connecting these research structures to the FrontierNav, the party gets data about the surrounding area. There are many advantages to different Data Probes. On a FN Site that is a resource vein, it is possible to install a Data Probe that automatically extracts currently used minerals, Miranium, and Precious Resources. The different types of Data Probes can be checked on the Wii U Gamepad. The Treasure Boxes and Missions allow the party to obtain specialized Data Probes that can be installed on FrontierNav and provide different effects. These probes are of finite quantity, but are fully reusabl
Deliverance Park (Japanese: , Seibu Pāku, Save Park) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Residential District of New Los Angeles.
Defensive Stance is a Longsword Battle Art in . It reduces damage taken and continually restores HP, but causes its users to deal less melee damage.
Data Miner (Japanese: , Āmuzu no Shimei) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Gigio west of Potter's Rock in Noctilum.
Dagger Puges (Japanese: , Dagā Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puges and can be found at level 15-20 near Mesa Fortress or on Stoyanov Trail in Oblivia.

Dead Man's Gulch (Japanese: , Shisha Keikoku) is an area in . It is located in Noctilum. It is accessible from a tunnel connecting the valley to the Dead Man's Ingress to the northeast (right near to FN Site 214). It must be visited during Chapter 6. It is inhabited only by Tainted.

Dead Man's Ingress (Japanese: , Shisha Keikoku Iriguchi) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, north of FN Site 214. It can be reached by passing through the thallus-infested tunnel or by going through Dead Man's Ingress BC. It is filled with Hidden Enemies.

Dana is a NPC in . She can be found at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles during the day. During the night, she can be found at Barista Court in the Commercial District. She is a member of the Interceptors Division.
Dagger Pugiliths (Japanese: , Dagā Berudero) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Pugilith machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 19 on the Seabird's Beak in Sylvalum.
Daredevil is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered when a party member with less than 30% of his or her HP uses an Art.
Deep Fang is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked by leveling up the Winged Viper class to rank 2.

Daylight Apricas (Japanese: , Sanraito Dometomu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Aprica family, and can be found at level 43-45 on Biahno Grassland and level 47-48 at Headwater Summit in Primordia during the day. Two must be defeated for Aprica Assault.
Dark Vespers (Japanese: , Dāku Usuperu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vesper family, and can be found at level 22-24 in the Castaway Cavern in Primordia.

Deadland Caro (Japanese: , Dezāto Nokkusu, Desert Nox) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family and can be found in Cauldros, at level 51 in a crater in Scholes Battlegrounds and at level 51-55 west of the Bestial Utopia. Three of them must be defeated during Cauldros Trailblazing 2.
Damage Immunity is a Buff in Xenoblade Chronicles which nullifies a certain amount of damage taken from attacks.
Debuff Immunity is a Buff in which prevents debuffs from being received.
Delft Turbas (Japanese: , Derufuto Kurekusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Turba family, and can be found at level 41 in the Secluded Lava Lake in Sylvalum.

The Decapotamon (Japanese: , Jūgawa Senkyō) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the plain around the Skybound Coil Tree in Noctilum. The FN Site 216 is directly north of the Decapotamon and the Decapotamon BC is on its eastern side. Three odd plants must be investigated here during Close Comrades, Mumutsu can be found here during Missing in Action, and Mia's comm device can be found here during Adventure!.
Dazbeno is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Dalton is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found just outside the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District.
Darting Caecuses (Japanese: , Dāto Doren) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caecus family, and can be found at level 31-32 on Cascade Isle in Noctilum.

Daimyo Ictuses (Japanese: , Daimyou Manda) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ictus family, and can be found at level 59-60 in Cauldros, outside the entrance of the Bestial Utopia.

Decapotamon Vista (Japanese: , Senkyō Ichibō) is a Scenic Viewpoint in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, north of the Canopied Nightwood. There are no enemies at the location proper, but a pair of Marnuck Recon can be found on the path right before reaching the location. Although it is named for having a good view of the Decapotamon, it cannot be reached directly from there. As with all Scenic Viewpoints, its discovery yields an achievement ("Conquering Decapotamon Vista").
